newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes steady late, activity moderate.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes steady late, activity moderate.

text.p: U.S. cash crude grades were steady late Wednesday in moderate activity, traders said.
June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing bounced back from earlier losses, trading around $21.35-45 a barrel on heavy short-covering.
July WTI/Cushing was running around 10 cents behind the June level, reinforcing the market contango in which prompt prices exceed forward ones.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James was steady around two to 10 cents above WTI/Cushing, with plus six cents last done.
WTI/Midland was last done around WTI/Cushing minus 32 cents a barrel, a penny stronger from an earlier deal.
Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire moved at minus 45 cents a barrel, down ten cents from today's earlier values and 20 cents from Tuesday, traders said.
West Texas Sour/Midland changed hands twice at minus $1.38 and $1.40 a barrel, confirming the weaker trend.
Lightly traded Eugene Island traded at minus $1.50 a barrel.
Exchange for Physical deals were running around plus six to eight cents, down from 12-13 cents on Tuesday.
